Former FA Cup Finalist Details Two Near-Fatal Drug Overdoses

Matt Lawrence, a former professional footballer and FA Cup finalist, has revealed he experienced two near-fatal drug overdoses within a four-day period in March 2021. The overdoses were reportedly caused by fentanyl-laced cocaine. After the first overdose, he was revived using Narcan, but he relapsed shortly after. Lawrence has spoken about his struggles with addiction, depression, and regret.
